{{Quote|Thyferra has three stellar-class spaceports&mdash;one at what is now being called Xucphra City. The other two are located on separate continents and are primarily used for the loading and unloading of bacta. Inbound ships stop at Xucphra City first for Customs and Immigration inspections, then are sent on to the spaceports to do business. They leave from those spaceports and head directly out to the destinations.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="XW:TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
A '''stellar-class starport''',<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref><ref name="SoN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref><ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> or '''stellar class starport''',<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref><ref name="PSG" /> was a type of [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]].<ref name="GG6" />

==Description==
The stellar-class [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] was a major [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hub.<ref name="TRPGSERE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> This type of port was capable of docking almost all classes and sizes of vessels.<ref name="GG8" />

The stellar-class starport often had several [[Shipyard/Legends|maintenance facilities]] in the immediate area for repairs and modifications.<ref name="GG8" /> These facilities were capable of performing nearly any sort of ship repair and customization that the owners wished.<ref name="GG6" /> These services usually were of advanced quality and moderately affordable.<ref name="PSG" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], most stellar-class starports had an [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs office]] on site and a sizable [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] presence in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="PSG" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The stellar-class starport was created by [[Mark Rein-Hagen]] and [[Stewart Wieck]] for ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook published in [[1990]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG6" />
